licensedPhoto.title: Greenway wayfinding on Eastern Avenue in 2020
licensedPhoto.alt: A Licking River Greenway and Trails sign with walking and bicycle symbols and an upward arrow on a pole beside Eastern Avenue, with sidewalk and road junctions visible.
licensedPhoto.caption: August 2, 2020 view of Greenway wayfinding on Eastern Avenue in Covington’s Levassor Park neighborhood. The frame shows the sign, a roadside sidewalk and street junctions, providing historical wayfinding context.
licensedPhoto.author: Warren LeMay (w_lemay)
licensedPhoto.limitations: This is a neighborhood wayfinding sign, not the trailhead itself or a continuous parking-to-trail route. No curb-ramp continuity, gradient, sidewalk width, current sign condition or safe street crossing is verified. Full original frame retained, resized from 3024 × 4032 to 1200 × 1600 and converted to WebP without scene changes.

guides.title: Northern Kentucky field-trip social story
guides.description: Nine pages show the Suite 400 storefront and marked parking, padded gym floor, climbing and trampoline steps, swings, the calming room, and art/play tables. Staff-help and turn-taking pages use cartoons. Page 3 visibly requires socks, while its text layer retains an older barefoot option; check the current branch footwear policy. Photos have unknown capture dates. They do not establish door clearances, a continuous arrival route, transfer assistance, toilets or changing facilities. Original images remain with the gym; no reuse licence was found.
guides.publisher: We Rock the Spectrum — Northern Kentucky
guides.documentDate: Created January 2023; modified February 2024; November 2024 upload path; photo dates unknown

guides.title: Porch steps, interior staircase and seating gallery
guides.description: Sixteen inspected photographs on the About page include steps to the front porch, steps at the side porch beside a paved passage, an interior staircase, mixed chairs and tables, low cushion seating and the tea room. Murals, hanging fixtures and patterned ceilings provide visual-environment context. No complete step-free route or absence of another entrance/lift is established; current layout, dimensions, toilets and door controls remain unknown. Capture dates are unspecified and some signs use KungBrew. Photographs are credited to Cintia Villalobos; no reuse licence was found, so view the originals.
guides.documentDate: Photo capture dates unknown; older KungBrew signs visible

guides.title: Nature-center frontage and paved seating area
guides.description: Three official gallery photographs show the nature-center building, a circular paved area with two backed benches, and the resource-center sign beside a partially visible path. Branches and planting border the seating space. These partial, undated views do not establish gradients, measured clearances, parking-to-path continuity, indoor entry or toilet availability. The building’s separate entry restrictions still apply. Original photographs remain with Cincinnati Parks; no reuse licence was found.

guides.title: Historical bridge, paved path and winter riverside photographs
guides.description: The city’s 2019 completion article includes photographs of the pedestrian bridge being installed, cyclists atop the levee, visitors on a paved path beside a railing, and a lower wooded area with snow and water. Nine photographs were inspected, including park and nature context. Bridge installation is dated May 2018 by the article; other capture dates are unspecified. The scenes do not establish current route continuity, gradients, bridge operation, seasonal maintenance or a safe flood diversion. Some original scenes include visitors or workers. Images remain at the source; no reuse licence was found.
guides.documentDate: Article September 17, 2019; bridge installation May 2018; other captures unknown

guides.title: Care Closet room door, racks, counter and stair-adjacent space
guides.description: Twelve candidate photographs were inspected; five useful views show the UC 142 door with lever handle and glazed side panel, a service counter, closely spaced wheeled racks, rugs, a fitting-area curtain and a seating/display area beside stairs. These are partial views, not a continuous route from a campus entrance or a measured aisle/fitting-room assessment. Capture dates are unknown; some image labels reference 2025 without proving when photographs were taken. Some original images contain visitors or staff; group portraits and event-only views add no route evidence. Current layout, alternative routes, toilets and assistance remain unverified. No reuse licence was found; images stay on NKU’s page.

guides.title: Campus routes and power-door entrance symbols
guides.description: One-page campus diagram linked by Student Accessibility, visually reviewed in full. University Center is building 22; the legend distinguishes plaza- and ground-level routes, power-door entrances, disability parking and bus stops. It does not show the indoor route to UC 142, toilets or elevator operation. The sheet says revised June 2025, its filename includes September 19, 2025, and construction areas are historical map markings. A separate official-host version uses different building numbers. Both maps print a $9.75 garage maximum; the visitor page’s 2026–27 schedule instead lists $12. Confirm current routes and parking terms. This is a map, not a documentary photograph; the original remains at NKU.
guides.documentDate: Revised June 2025 on sheet; September 19, 2025 in filename

visualReview.pdfBreakdown: All nine WRTS social-story pages and both one-page NKU map versions. Only the map linked by Student Accessibility is published as a guide.
visualReview.note: Candidate views are not all unique scenes; Fei pages include repeated photographs. Full-resolution key entrances/stairs and the final licensed image were inspected. No screenshot, rendering, generated image or altered scene is counted as a documentary photograph.
